weapons.name: MDR-X .308 Winchester
weapons.source_note: Desert Tech MDRx Technical Specifications table: the .308 Win column (16" and 20" barrels) gives "Barrel Twist 1:10". States a 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: SRS-A1 .308 Winchester
weapons.source_note: Desert Tech SRS .308 Winchester precision match grade 22" barrel specifications: "Compatible with All SRS-A2, M2 & SRS-A1 chassis, Standard or Covert Barrel Twist 1 in 11"". States a 1 turn in 11 inch twist = 279.4 mm per turn for the SRS-A1 .308 Win barrel.

weapons.name: DB10 AR-10-pattern semi-automatic carbine, 16" barrel
weapons.source_note: Diamondback Firearms DB10, 16", Carbon Series manufacturer specifications: "Barrel: 16 in, 1:10 RH, Light, 4150 CrMov, Black Nitride". States a right-hand 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: DB380 ultra-compact .380 ACP pocket pistol
weapons.source_note: Diamondback Firearms DB380 Gen4 manufacturer specifications: "Barrel Twist Rate: 1:10 RH". States a right-hand 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Sidekick 9-shot .22 LR double-action revolver, 2" barrel
weapons.source_note: Diamondback Firearms Sidekick manufacturer specifications: "Barrel Twist: 1:16 RH" and "Grooves: 6". States a right-hand 1 turn in 16 inch twist = 406.4 mm per turn with six grooves. The 2" barrel variant is not a catalogued Sidekick length; the smallest listed is the 3" Birdshead, which shares the same 1:16 RH twist.

weapons.name: Petra .300 Winchester Magnum
weapons.source_note: Falkor Defense PETRA manufacturer Features list: "Barrel: 22-inch Bartlein steel with a 1:9 Twist". States a 1 turn in 9 inch twist = 228.6 mm per turn.

weapons.name: MSBS Grot C Carbine
weapons.source_note: FB "Lucznik" Radom (Fabryka Broni) official MSBS GROT Technical data: "Barrel length: 406 mm" and "Number and twist rate of grooves: 6 / 178mm". The Grot C16 carbine barrel length matches this entry. States a 178 mm per turn twist (approximately 1 turn in 7 inch) with six grooves.

weapons.name: MSBS Grot R Rifle
weapons.source_note: FB "Lucznik" Radom (Fabryka Broni) official MSBS GROT Technical data: "Barrel length: 406 mm" and "Number and twist rate of grooves: 6 / 178mm". The Grot R service rifle shares this 406 mm barrel and twist. States a 178 mm per turn twist (approximately 1 turn in 7 inch) with six grooves.

weapons.name: FNX-45 Pistol
weapons.source_note: FN America FNX-45 Tactical Specs table: "Twist Rate: 1:16\" RH". The FNX-45 and FNX-45 Tactical share the same barrel twist. States a right-hand 1 turn in 16 inch twist = 406.4 mm per turn.

weapons.name: SCAR-H Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: FN eStore (manufacturer) SCAR 17S barrel assembly: "Cold hammer-forged, chrome-lined, free-floating barrel with muzzle device for SCAR 17S in 7.62x51mm, 1:12\" twist." The SCAR-H/Mk 17 uses the SCAR 17S barrel. States a 1 turn in 12 inch twist = 304.8 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Model 83 .357 Magnum 6"
weapons.source_note: Freedom Arms Inc. Revolver Specifications chart, Model 83 .357 MAG entries: the 6" barrel row gives "1-14" under the Twist column. States a 1 turn in 14 inch twist = 355.6 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Model 97 .357 Magnum 5.5"
weapons.source_note: Freedom Arms Inc. Revolver Specifications chart, Model 97 .357 MAG entries: the 5.5" barrel row gives "1-14" under the Twist column. States a 1 turn in 14 inch twist = 355.6 mm per turn.
